headlines.title: WD to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
SanDisk Falls 7% as AI Chip Selloff Hits Memory Stocks Despite Evercore’s $2,500 Target; Micron and Western Digital Drop 6%
headlines.summary: Evercore just reaffirmed a sky-high target, yet SanDisk shares kept sliding while rivals fell less. What makes this flash pure play more exposed than Micron or the drive makers, and can its bull case survive the AI selloff?

headlines.title: Western Digital Corp. (WDC) Faces Growing AI Spending Concerns After 17% Selloff
headlines.summary: We just published our list, 10 Worst AI Infrastructure and Data Center Stocks to Buy According to Short Sellers, and Western Digital Corp. ranked 10th on this list. A steep selloff is unfolding around AI infrastructure and data center stocks, reflecting growing investor concerns about the sustainability of the AI investment boom and elevated valuations.

headlines.title: A $13 Billion Hedge Fund Dumps These 3 Stocks
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysWhale Rock Capital, a hedge fund firm managing nearly $13 billion, sold all its Astera Labs, Carvana and Western Digital stock in the third quarter while building up Meta and SiTime. Astera Labs and Western Digital are each down 54% since June 30, the last date the fund reported owning them, while Carvana is up 10%.

headlines.title: Western Digital Stock Gains Fresh Attention After Earnings Beat and AI Storage Demand Strengthens
headlines.summary: Western Digital recently reported quarterly results that exceeded earlier expectations, with revenue growth, higher margins and strong demand for AI data center storage capacity. The business is seeing a large share of activity tied to AI driven workloads, which reinforces how critical Western Digital’s drives have become in hyperscale infrastructure planning. The focus now shifts to what this stronger AI storage demand might mean for Western Digital’s longer term investment narrative.

description: Western Digital Corporation engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of data storage devices and solutions based on hard disk drive (HDD) technology in the United States, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The company offers internal HDDs, data center drives, data center platforms, external drives, portable drives, NAS for home and office, and accessories. It sells its data storage devices and solutions through its computer sales personnel, dealers, distributors, retailers, and subsidiaries. The company has a collaboration with Open Quantum Design for the development of quantum error correction technology and related systems to advance reliable quantum computing. Western Digital Corporation was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
